content:
If sentiment is >0.5 in the last 3 days and forecast is rising, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% for early horizon (1–7 days).

If sentiment is <0.5 in the last 3 days and forecast is falling, increase forecast by 0.5–1.0% for mid horizon (8–15 days).

If sentiment is >0.5 and forecast is flat, add 0.3–0.7% upward bias for late horizon (16–30 days).

If sentiment spikes >0.75 in last 2 days and forecast is below recent low, add 1.0–1.5% upward correction.

If sentiment is consistently <0.3 and forecast is above recent high, subtract 0.5–1.0% for all horizons.

If sentiment is mixed (0.3–0.7) and forecast deviates >1.5% from 14-day moving average, apply linear correction toward average.
